newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.18 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.18 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 29.055 to the dollar after Thursday's fixing at 28.784, and at 17.183 to the mark from 17.040.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.18 percent, up from +3.03 on Thursday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown was at +2.12 on the interbank market.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
